Task.description: User-visible unit of One-shot work. A Task may contain multiple immutable Runs.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Origin snapshot: api, telegram, mobile or web and channel address metadata.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Original requested work. Follow-up input belongs to the new Delivery/Run.

fields.name: runtime_context_id
fields.description: Provider continuity metadata; never a PTY Session ID.

invariants: principal_kind, principal_id, project_id, provider_id, source and original prompt are immutable
at most one Run for the Task may be active
current_run_id, when present, references a Run owned by the same Task
runtime_context_id, when present, references a RuntimeContext with the same principal, project and provider
Task outcome transitions never rewrite an earlier Run; continue and retry create a new Delivery and Run
cancelled is terminal; a new Task is required to execute again

Delivery.description: Reliable request to start or resume one Run. Channel delivery is a separate concept.

fields.name: input
fields.description: Prompt delta, attachment references and requested options.

invariants: one Delivery creates at most one Run and run_id is immutable once assigned
a reserved Delivery has a non-empty lease_owner and future lease_until
acknowledged, dead_letter and cancelled are terminal
notification retry never creates or mutates a Delivery
the same principal and idempotency key with the same payload returns the original result

Run.description: One immutable ordinary child-process execution attempt.
invariants: one Run starts at most one ordinary child process and never allocates a PTY
delivery_id is unique across Runs
terminal Run states are immutable
finished_at is required in every terminal state
exit_code and failure metadata describe the child process and are never inferred from channel delivery

RuntimeContext.description: Provider continuity metadata used by a later ordinary process; it contains no live process.
invariants: RuntimeContext has no Session ID, PID, PTY or process handle
only its owning principal, project and provider may acquire it
busy prevents concurrent Runs
invalid and revoked are terminal
resume failure never silently creates a replacement context

StreamRecord.description: Ordered persisted bytes received from stdout or stderr.
invariants: sequence is globally unique and strictly increasing within a Run across stdout and stderr
raw bytes are preserved even when text decoding fails
records are append-only

StandardEvent.description: Adapter-normalized append-only Run event traceable to raw output when applicable.
invariants: sequence is unique and increasing within a Run
adapter-derived content never replaces the raw StreamRecord
events are append-only and adapter/version traceable

Artifact.description: Immutable content-addressed output or attachment belonging to a Task and optionally one Run.
invariants: artifact content is immutable and verified by sha256
storage_key is server-controlled and never a client-supplied absolute path
authorization follows Task ownership

states.name: pending
states.description: Validated Task exists but no Delivery has been queued.

states.name: queued
states.description: A runnable Delivery is pending or reserved.

states.name: running
states.description: The current Run owns a live ordinary process or is collecting output.

states.name: waiting_input
states.description: The previous Run exited after requesting user input; continue may queue another Run.

states.name: completed
states.description: The latest Run completed; explicit continue may queue another Run using RuntimeContext.

states.name: failed
states.description: The latest Run failed; explicit retry or eligible continue may queue another Run.

states.name: cancelled
states.description: Task cancelled. Re-execution requires a new Task.

states.name: timed_out
states.description: The latest Run timed out; explicit retry or eligible continue may queue another Run.

transitions.guard: Delivery exhausted or non-retryable start failure
Run process exited and output persisted
Run failed and compensation completed or recorded
process tree terminated or already absent
active owned RuntimeContext and new Delivery
active owned RuntimeContext and new Delivery
new Delivery; continue also requires active RuntimeContext
new Delivery; continue also requires active RuntimeContext

states.name: pending
states.description: Eligible for reservation at available_at.

states.name: reserved
states.description: Owned by one worker lease.

states.name: retry_wait
states.description: Transient pre-execution failure; becomes reservable at available_at.

states.name: acknowledged
states.description: Execution responsibility durably resolved.

states.name: dead_letter
states.description: No further automatic reservation.

states.name: cancelled
states.description: Cancelled before responsibility was completed.

transitions.guard: Run outcome or recovered commit durably recorded
retryable failure before a new child process is started and attempts remain
process not started or cancellation cleanup resolved

states.name: created
states.description: Persisted but process start not attempted.

states.name: starting
states.description: Credentials and process start are in progress.

states.name: running
states.description: Ordinary child process is alive.

states.name: collecting_output
states.description: Child exited or is terminating; pipes/artifacts are being drained and committed.

states.name: waiting_input
states.description: Process exited with normalized waiting-input outcome.

states.name: completed
states.description: Successful immutable Run outcome.

states.name: failed
states.description: Failed immutable Run outcome.

states.name: cancelled
states.description: Process tree terminated or already absent by cancellation.

states.name: timed_out
states.description: Process tree terminated after deadline.

transitions.guard: Delivery reserved and Task owns no active Run
wait result known; pipes still drainable
failure recorded and process cleanup resolved
process tree terminated or already absent
deadline reached and process tree terminated
all output committed and adapter outcome requests input

states.name: active
states.description: Available for one owner-authorized continuation.

states.name: busy
states.description: Acquired by one non-terminal Run.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Provider context cannot be resumed.

states.name: revoked
states.description: Owner or system permanently disabled use.

transitions.guard: owner/project/provider match and optimistic lock succeeds
owning Run reached terminal state and context remains resumable

idempotency.identity_scope: principal_kind + principal_id + method + canonical path + key
idempotency.payload_binding: SHA-256 of canonical JSON body and immutable source attachment references
idempotency.same_payload: return the original status and response without creating another Task, Delivery or Run
idempotency.telegram_dedup: unique channel_id + source_message_id before Task creation

pagination.consistency: cursor encodes stable sort values and resource ID; callers must not construct it

timestamps.comparison: database time is authoritative for leases and state transitions

error_envelope.security: message/details must not expose secrets, raw credentials, unregistered absolute paths or provider tokens

audit.rule: write actions and denied owner/scope checks must be auditable; secret values and raw prompt bodies are excluded
